name: Build Android APK

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: frontend

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'

      - name: Set up JDK 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '17'
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Cache Gradle
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.gradle/caches
            ~/.gradle/wrapper
          key: gradle-${{ hashFiles('frontend/android/**/*.gradle*', 'frontend/android/**/gradle-wrapper.properties') }}
          restore-keys: |
            gradle-

      - name: Install Node dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Set up Android SDK local.properties
        run: echo "sdk.dir=$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT" > android/local.properties

      - name: Grant Gradle execute permission
        run: chmod +x android/gradlew

      - name: Build Debug APK
        run: cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-daemon --stacktrace
        env:
          GRADLE_OPTS: '-Dorg.gradle.jvmargs=-Xmx2g -XX:MaxMetaspaceSize=512m'

      - name: Upload APK artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: nshare-debug-apk
          path: frontend/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
          retention-days: 30
